name: mcp-bridge
title: MCP Bridge for ChatGPT
description: Host any npm MCP server as HTTP/SSE endpoint for ChatGPT

input.title: MCP Bridge Input
input.description: Configure which MCP server to host. Easiest: use Smithery Server ID.

smitheryServer.title: Smithery Server
smitheryServer.description: Paste the server ID from smithery.ai (e.g., '@VapiAI/vapi-mcp-server')

smitheryApiKey.title: Smithery API Key
smitheryApiKey.description: Get your API key from https://smithery.ai/account/api-keys

package.title: NPM Package (Alternative)
package.description: Or npm package name to install and run directly.

version.title: Package Version
version.description: Optional: specific version (only for NPM Package mode).

command.title: Custom Command (Alternative)
command.description: Or custom command (e.g., 'npx') with args below.

args.title: CLI Arguments
args.description: Arguments for Custom Command or NPM Package mode.

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Optional: environment variables for the MCP server (e.g., API keys)
